No problems found under these assumptions. An existing return via 0.8 mm from DQ0
already contacts inner1 and inner4 within the advisory 1 mm screen.
Near (0, 0) mm.
Keep it; another stitching via is not needed here.
Signal candidates; DDR membership is unknown. Geometry screening only; impedance, timing
and boot are not evaluated.
